claim_boundary: Episodes are reconstructed from multi-action Route decision samples, not continuous queue telemetry; start/end are first sampled crossings.

signal_audit.signal_definition: max(candidate-consistent current junction_queue_length, candidate-consistent current priority_local_contention)

thresholds.rationale: enter at at least 16 local queued/contending bags and exit at at most 8; the two-to-one band suppresses decision-sample jitter
